This category lists those categories that are hidden. These categories would appear on a main namespace article, but are not part of the main category structure. An example would be [[:Category:Pages with broken file links|Pages with broken file links]]. These categories are for the maintenance of the site, rather than cataloging the articles. [[:Category:Stubs|Stubs]] and pages [[Special:UncategorizedPages|that are uncategorized]] should not be included here. Logged in contributors may change their preferences to see these categories listed on the articles.
